messages:
Bea: Quick Q for an offer: contractor starts 11/15 and might accrue a couple sick days before offboarding. Can we promise conversion to a floating day or payout? Also, is there any wiggle for a blackout exception for 12/16-12/18 (launch week)?

Olivia (People Ops): Do not promise conversion in the offer. Contractors only get what the SOW specifies. We can approve a one-time stipend or invoice adjustment as an exception with manager + People Ops + Legal signoff. For blackout windows, manager must submit a coverage plan; exceptions are rare.

Bea: Got it. Payroll constraints?

Noah (Payroll): If you request a cash stipend, we need written signoff and the final invoice date before payroll cutoff. For November pay runs, cutoff is 11/28; for December invoice adjustments, 12/10. Floating days for contractors are not supported unless hired as W-2.

Bea: Suggested offer sentence: "Unused sick may be considered for a one-time exception (cash or amendment to SOW) at People Ops and Finance discretion; not guaranteed." OK?

Olivia (People Ops): That wording works. Add: "If contractor, subject to Legal review and invoice cutoffs."

Bea: Second, I'll ask manager to file coverage plan for the 12/16-12/18 request.

people-ops-bot: New exception ticket created: #HR-2345-900 03 attach manager approval and coverage plan. Triage ETA 2 business days.

Olivia (People Ops): Thanks Bea 12 ping me when the ticket has attachments and I'll route to Legal/Finance if stipend is requested.
